description.value: Reanimators defy the laws of nature in pursuit of gruesome experiment, stitching together undead servants from disparate corpses and fusing necromancy with voltaic science.
Bards of the College of Spirits seek tales from beyond, whispered by discarnate souls and ancestral phantoms, channeling otherworldy lore through spiritual foci.
Gods of the grave watch over the sacred boundary between life and death. To these clerics, death is a natural transition, and undeath is a desecration to be laid to rest.
Rangers who commune with hollow, ancient, decayed woods, channeling rot and rebirth to hunt those who violate the wild.
Masters of death who walk the borderline between life and the spirit world, harvesting soul trinkets from the fallen.
Sorcerers whose innate spark of power is drawn from the Fell darkness of the Shadowfell, manipulating gloom and hounds of ill omen.
Warlocks who bind themselves to a mysterious entity of the Shadowfell that manifests through sentient blades carved of shadow and soulcraft.
Your patron is a master of undeath — such as an ancient lich, elder vampire, or mummy lord — conferring the dark boons of eternity.
Fighters who master the ancient elven tradition of weaving arcane magic into archery, producing supernatural and devastating effects.
Monks who etch arcane cosmic power directly into living mystical tattoos across their skin, channeling beasts, celestials, and titans.
Wizards who specialize in Conjuration magic, teleporting effortlessly through space and summoning durable thralls of the multiverse.
Masters of magical charm and mental manipulation, bending minds and splitting enchantments across multiple adversaries.
Scholars of the mysteries of life and death, commanding empowered undead hordes and reaping the vitality of slain foes.
Masters of alchemy and physical alteration who forge the Transmuter's Stone to bestow elemental resilience and miraculous transformations.
Clerics who worship deities of magic, weaving divine reverence with arcane secrets and unraveling adverse enchantments.
Sorcerers whose powers awaken through communion with the enduring spirits and heroic legends of their ancestral bloodline.
Bards of the College of the Moon channel the ancient legends and spiritual springs of the Moonshae Isles, using folktales to embolden allies with primal magic.
Gods of knowledge prize learning and universal truth. Their clerics master esoteric secrets, pierce deceptive thoughts, and foresee impending destiny.
Elite knights of Cormyr who ride into battle alongside loyal amethyst dragon wyrmlings, rallying allies with courageous command.
Paladins who uphold the ancient treaties of the noble genies, wreathing their sacred smites in the fury of the Elemental Chaos.
Rangers who roam the frostbitten peaks and frozen wastes, commanding blizzard magic to freeze predators and prey alike.
Rogues bound to the grim legacy of the Dead Three (Bane, Bhaal, and Myrkul), mastering ruthless brutality and fear-driven assassination.
Sorcerers blessed with the legendary Spellfire—the rare ability to channel raw Weave energy, absorb hostile spells, and project radiant silver flame.
Wizards who master the ancient elven tradition of weaving graceful swordplay with lethal combat wizardry.
Druids dedicated to shielding the fragile embers of life across apocalyptic wastelands, creating verdant sanctuaries of enduring restoration.
Fighters forged in bloodstained arenas, turning brutal spectacle into deadly combat mastery with crippling maneuvers.
Sorcerers who empower their magic by greedily leeching life from the soil and surrounding creatures in a blight of defilement.
Warlocks pledged to god-like sorcerer-kings, wielding psionic authority and absolute tyranny over minds and battlefields.
Monks initiated into esoteric academies of mystical warfare, weaving spellcraft seamlessly through fluid martial forms.
Paladins sworn to counter rogue sorcery, shattering hostile concentration, dispelling curses, and shielding allies from arcane malice.
Rogues who pilfer magical energy straight from enemy spellcasters and enchanted relics, transmuting it into force-infused strikes.
Warlocks who bind themselves to the spectral remnants of forgotten gods and ancient souls, fighting beside a haunting vestige companion.
Barbarians on the Path of Unlight embrace uncontrollable radiant magic from the Underdark in exchange for incredible physical prowess and blazing fury.
Trained in the intrigue of noble houses of the Underdark, House Agents are master infiltrators who strike when their target's back is turned.
Scholars of the ancient secrets of Deep Imaskar who master Unlight to both heal allies and curse enemies with radiant doom.
Barbarians walking the Path of Lament hone their regrets into deadly weapons, propelled by supernatural grief and gifts from beyond the grave.
Warriors of Venom pollute their internal power to become poison incarnate, harnessing their own toxicity to impair and envenom foes.
Your pact draws on the Inner Planes, heralding ancient and destructive scions of elemental chaos and preparing the way for their arrival.
Druids of the Circle of the Titan assume towering, monstrous forms to mete out cataclysmic retribution and forcibly restore the natural order.
Champions of archdevils and high-ranking fiends of the Nine Hells, armed with hell-forged weapons to inflict infernal wounds and damn enemies.
The corruptive magic of demons courses through you, making you a conduit for the infinite horrors and reality-warping chaos of the Abyss.
Barbarians calling upon ancestral spirits to guide, defend their comrades, shield allies from harm, and lash out with vengeful strikes.
Harness Rage into a mantle of primal magic swirling like a storm, unleashing the fury of the Desert, Sea, or Tundra.
Defenders of allies on foot or from a mount, excelling at mounted combat, warding maneuvers, and holding the defensive line.
Monks who sway and stumble to confound foes, drinking mystic brews for potent benefits and unleashing chaotic frenzies of unarmed strikes.
Paladins who shattered their sacred vows for dark ambition or corruption, wielding dread auras, necromancy, and overwhelming malice.
